The present application has been filed seeking correction of the order dated 07.02.2024, passed
by this Hon'ble Court.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that vide order dated 07.02.2024, the FIR No.0927/2014 was quashed.
However, the Sections invoked in the said FIR have not been correctly mentioned in paras 2 and 11 of the said order due to inadvertence.
3. She submits that the FIR was registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
However, in the said order inadvertently Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act has not been mentioned.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The present petition has been filed under Section 482 CrPC seeking quashing of FIR No.0927/2014 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act registered at Police Station New Usmanpur and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.
Consequently, the petition is allowed and the FIR No.0927/2014 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act registered at Police Station New Usmanpur alongwith all other proceedings emanating therefrom, is quashed."
5. With the aforesaid corrections, the application stands disposed of.
